entry.summary: What this site is for, and what I plan to put on it.
entry.content: This is my first post. I'll write about anything here: bug bounty writeups, security research, tools I build, my journey, or whatever else comes to mind. Mostly I'm writing it down for myself, but If it ends up useful for someone else, I'm happy.
